title: knautia carpathica
intro: Knautia carpathica, commonly known as Edelraute, is a flowering plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and relieving anxiety and stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties. The health benefits of Knautia carpathica include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory problems, and supporting the immune system, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
